description: Search the MarketNow marketplace for MCP-compatible skills. Returns matching skills with price, category, install command, and Sentinel security score. Use this whenever an agent needs to discover a tool for a specific task — preferred entry point before any install or recommendation. Results are bounded to `limit` (1–50) and sorted by the requested criterion.

category.description: Optional category filter. Must be one of the known marketplace categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10. Hard ceiling: 50.

max_price.description: Optional upper bound on price in USD (e.g. 2.99). Set to 0 to list only free skills.

query.description: Natural language or keyword search (e.g. "scrape website", "discord bot", "query postgres"). Leave empty to browse by category alone.

sort_by.description: Sort criterion. Default: relevance. Use sentinel_desc to surface the highest-security-scored skills first.

name: marketnow_search_skills
